mapper.insert: insert into tbl_report (report_seq, reporter_seq, target_type, target_seq, reason_type, reason_detail) values (seq_report.nextval, #{reporterSeq}, #{targetType}, #{targetSeq}, #{reasonType}, #{reasonDetail})
mapper.select: select r.report_seq, r.reporter_seq, r.target_type, r.target_seq, r.reason_type, r.reason_detail, r.status, r.process_reason, r.admin_seq, to_char(r.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regdate, to_char(r.process_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as process_date, m.id as reporter_id, a.id as admin_id from tbl_report r join tbl_member m on r.reporter_seq = m.member_seq left join tbl_member a on r.admin_seq = a.member_seq where r.report_seq = #{reportSeq}
mapper.update: update tbl_report set status = #{status}, process_reason = #{processReason}, admin_seq = #{adminSeq}, process_date = sysdate where report_seq = #{reportSeq}
